visual_review.reasoning: The render shows only a plain gray cylinder (the service module body) with what appears to be a disconnected, floating disk/sphere with lines near it — there is no cone-shaped command module on top, no main engine bell at the bottom, and no properly attached thrust modules. The overall silhouette does not read as the Apollo CSM at all.
visual_review.suggested_fix: Rebuild the model with three clearly connected components stacked along a single vertical axis: (1) a truncated cone (command module) at the top, narrower end pointing up, flush with the top of the cylinder; (2) a cylinder (service module) in the middle as the main body; (3) a bell-shaped nozzle (main Service Propulsion System engine) attached to and centered on the bottom face of the cylinder. Add four small rectangular Reaction Control System (RCS) thrust quad packages evenly spaced around the circumference of the service module cylinder. All parts must share the same central axis, touch at their interfaces with no gaps, and be given appropriate colors (silver/white for the SM body, dark gray for the engine bell, light gray for the CM cone).
